title: Viettel Cyberbot
overview: Production chatbot platform serving Viettel Money, MB Bank, VPBank, and Mcredit with 5M+ monthly messages, multi-channel embedding (iframe, Facebook, WebView), and 99.9% uptime.
challenge: Design multi-channel chatbot platform supporting concurrent live chat, real-time messaging, and high-throughput API calls (500+ req/s peak) while maintaining low latency (<500ms) under production load across multiple banking clients.
contributions: Architected full-stack chatbot application (Laravel + Vue.js) with CMS-driven bot logic configuration (scenarios, entities, patterns), enabling non-technical staff to manage complex conversation flows.
Built multi-channel embedding system: iframe, Facebook Messenger WebView with isolated context, request queuing for reliability under 10K+ concurrent users.
Designed Admin Dashboard (Vue.js + Laravel) for real-time analytics (message volume, conversion metrics), live chat agent workload distribution, and RBAC user management with SSO integration.

Optimized database performance: eliminated N+1 queries through eager loading, added strategic indexes reducing query time by 70%, implemented two-tier caching (Redis cache layer + query result cache).
Enhanced real-time messaging: tuned Socket.IO + Laravel Echo Server for stability under 5000+ concurrent connections, implemented connection pooling and graceful degradation.
Improved CI/CD pipelines: GitLab CI multi-stage builds, automated testing, Docker containerization, coordinated multi-service deployments via ArgoCD on Kubernetes.
Set up observability stack: Prometheus metrics (throughput, latency p50/p99), Grafana dashboards for monitoring bot health, enabled rapid incident debugging across distributed services.
